notes: Native-green 17-assertion available-dimension reference witness. Public Create accepts object- and interaction-class available dimensions declared by a later compatible DIF module; joined object/interaction available-dimension queries expose exactly that dimension and its upper bound. Public Create rejects an unresolved dimension name, then permits valid federation-name reuse. Direct mappings are to 1516.2 clauses 4.7.1, 6.2.5, 6.2.6, and Annex C. Existing same-class dimension-union tests cover a different merge rule. Region operations, per-attribute dimension constraints, broader Annex C merge, Java runtime, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
